description: A very modern, elegant, premium, minimalist web application acting as a creative co-pilot. It is NOT a standard Photoshop clone. Priority is a white background theme with highly refined typography, generous whitespace, subtle rounded corners, and tasteful glassmorphism.

fonts.name: Cabinet Grotesk
fonts.description: Used for all headings to give an unexpected, high-end editorial and modern feel. Do NOT use Inter for headings.

fonts.name: Manrope
fonts.description: Clean, highly readable geometric sans-serif for UI text, chat bubbles, and paragraphs.

rules.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none

rules.accents: Use monochromatic contrast (Black/White) for primary actions. Use very subtle, sophisticated cool grays or warm silver for AI elements. NO cheap gradients.

spacing_and_layout.grid_bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-6 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8

hero.layout: Centered or left-aligned massive typography. Focus on the question: 'Apa yang ingin kamu buat hari ini?'
hero.styling: High contrast, pure minimal. No messy backgrounds.

action_cards.layout: Bento Grid Mode A (Tetris Grid). Span logic to make cards unequal and interesting. E.g., 'Edit Foto' spans 6 cols, 'AI Creative Assistant' spans 12 cols.
action_cards.styling: Apple Crystal Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-2xl, bg-white/70, 1px inner border white/40) OR Solid Surface (#F5F5F7). Hover states lift the card slightly (-translate-y-2) with a very soft shadow (shadow-[0_20px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)]).
action_cards.content: Include the Unsplash images provided, utilizing masking or beautiful object-fit.

chat_interface.layout: Apple Messages style layout. Professional, clean.
chat_interface.bubbles: User: Black background, White text. AI: Light Gray (#F5F5F7) background, Black text. Maximum border radius (rounded-[24px]), except for the tail end.

buttons.styling: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Pure Black with White text for primary. Minimalist scale-down on click (active:scale-95). Subtle ring on focus.

editor_workspace.layout: Split view: Large preview area (70%) + Floating Chat/Context Panel (30%).
editor_workspace.styling: Use dark mode locally for the preview container (to focus on media) while keeping the chat panel in the user's preferred theme.

motion_and_interactions.page_load: Staggered fade-up for hero text and bento grid cards.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Cards scale by 1.02 and lift slightly. Images inside cards slowly zoom in (scale-105 over 1s) on hover.
motion_and_interactions.chat_animation: Messages appear with a gentle spring animation (y: 10 to 0, opacity: 0 to 1).

edit_photo.description: Studio setup for Edit Photo card.

edit_video.description: Cinematic camera for Edit Video card.

ai_generate.description: Abstract white/purple art for AI Generation cards.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. FRAMEWORK: Use React, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, and Lucide React. Prioritize a mobile-first, highly responsive approach.

2. THEME SETUP: Force a White dominant theme. Do not build a generic dark mode dashboard unless explicitly toggled by the user. Inject Fontshare (Cabinet Grotesk) and Google Fonts (Manrope) into the index.html or global CSS.
3. TYPOGRAPHY: Apply font-cabinet to all standard h1-h6 tags. Use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter for large headings. Keep body text highly legible in Manrope.
4. HERO SECTION: Build a massive, high-contrast hero section with 'Apa yang ingin kamu buat hari ini?' as the focal point. Use minimal surrounding visual noise.

5. BENTO GRID: Implement the 6 main actions (Edit Foto, Edit Video, Buat Gambar AI, Buat Video AI, AI Creative Assistant, Project Saya) using an asymmetric grid layout (Tetris style). Avoid perfect symmetry.
6. CHAT UI: The conversational editor must NOT look like ChatGPT. It should look like an elegant Apple Messages thread. Use pure black/white/light gray bubbles with rounded-[24px] corners.

7. COMPONENTS: Build custom Shadcn-like components (or use pure Tailwind/Framer) for Selectors, Modals, and Upload Dropzones. Ensure no component uses an entirely transparent background that overlaps content.
8. WORKFLOWS: Ensure the 'Edit Photo' and 'Edit Video' workflows implement the 'Upload -> Reference -> Chat -> Generate' pipeline cleanly, using steps or side-by-side split screens.
9. PWA: Include basic PWA meta tags and a mock 'Install App' prompt to fulfill the requirement.
10. TESTING: Add 'data-testid' attributes to all buttons, links, and major panels.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and soft, diffuse shadows.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) combined with a subtle 1px border.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in CSS. Keep natural reading flow.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, with interaction animations & scale down on click.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons. Use Phosphor or Lucide icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable (p-8, p-12). Cramped designs look cheap.
